name: 63 PEDRO
description: 63 Pedro is an advanced, high-scoring variation of the traditional American trick-taking game 'Pedro' (itself a derivative of All Fours and Pitch). Played with four players in fixed partnerships, it is famous for its massive point totalsâ€”a single round contains exactly 63 points. Points are awarded for capturing specific trump cards, with the King (30 points) and the 'Pedros' (the two 5s of the trump color) being the most sought-after prizes. It is a game of aggressive bidding and high-stakes trump management.

content.text: 63 Pedro is an advanced, high-scoring variation of the traditional American trick-taking game 'Pedro' (itself a derivative of All Fours and Pitch). Played with four players in fixed partnerships, it is famous for its massive point totalsâ€”a single round contains exactly 63 points. Points are awarded for capturing specific trump cards, with the King (30 points) and the 'Pedros' (the two 5s of the trump color) being the most sought-after prizes. It is a game of aggressive bidding and high-stakes trump management.
Developed in the late 19th-century American South and West as part of the 'All Fours' family of games. The 63-point variant specifically evolved to make bidding more granular and exciting.
52 cards. Trumps include the 'Left Pedro' (same color 5).
52 cards. Trumps include the 'Left Pedro' (same color 5).
Deal 9 cards to each player. After bidding, the deck is 'filled' and players discard down to 6 cards.
